mapper.insert: INSERT INTO guild_score_logs ( guild_id, user_id, battle_id, source_type, source_id, score, score_date, description ) VALUES ( #{guildId}, #{userId}, #{battleId}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{score}, #{scoreDate}, #{description} )
mapper.select: SELECT score_date, COALESCE(SUM(score), 0) AS score FROM guild_score_logs WHERE guild_id = #{guildId} AND score_date BETWEEN #{weekStartDate} AND #{weekEndDate} GROUP BY score_date ORDER BY score_date ASC
